messages:
maya: FYI discovered weird token accounting when router prefetches model variants for session-affinity + smart routing. Some requests show provisional credits that never resolve.

maya: Repro: client opens streaming session, router prefetches candidate model for canary, then stream does a tool call and gets truncated. Logs show two credit events.

maya: snippet:
```
POST /v1/stream
X-Session: s-abc123
Routing: smart-prefetch
```

jamal: Hmm. Is prefetching happening on every connect or only on route miss? Could be double counting if prefetch increments provisional ledger before KV lock taken.

oliver: Is the prefetch token accounted as confirmed or provisional? Our billing path treats provisional->confirmed on first produced token commit. If the stream truncates before commit we should revert but apparently we don't.

sara: Console ask: customers see final charge but not the provisional spikes — curious if we should surface provisional vs final on per-route graphs? Could help ops teams.

jamal: I think race is: prefetch creates provisional credit; stream triggers toolcall -> router retries to fallback model -> the fallback also prefetches and confirms, leaving the provisional orphaned.

oliver: If retries cause another prefetch + confirm we end up with both counts. We need idempotency at prefetch-level (prefetch-lease keyed by session+candidate-model).

maya: Proposed short-term: don't prefetch for sessions that enable streaming toolcalls or set prefetch TTL=0 for them. Longer-term: add prefetch lease reconciliation job.

sara: UX: expose a toggle 'Disable smart prefetch for streaming toolcalls' in Console per-customer and make it a canary rollout. Also show provisional spikes as a dotted line in billing graph.

ops-bot: deploy-check: canary rollout to 10% + metrics to watch: provisional_peak, confirmed_delta, refund_rate.

jamal: Also need to handle truncation: when the model truncates mid-toolcall we should emit a refund event and mark provisional as void. Current pipeline ignores truncation path.

oliver: Agreed. Action items: 1) jamal -> add prefetch lease/idempotency (prefetch id = session+model+attempt). 2) maya -> implement TTL-0 for streaming toolcalls in router config. 3) sara -> console flag + graph change. 4) ops -> canary + runbook.

maya: I'll open an internal PR with logs and a small synthetic test that reproduces double-charge. Will ping when ready :thumbsup:
